articles.event_key: Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy|公布发售日|PS5/Xbox Series/PC/Switch 2
articles.title: 《Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy》定于2027年1月28日发售
articles.summary: Owlcat Games公布《Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy》将于2027年1月28日登陆PS5、Xbox Series和PC，Switch 2版后续推出；本作为队伍制剧情cRPG。
articles.new_facts: 发售日定为2027年1月28日；登陆PS5、Xbox Series、PC，Switch 2后续；创始人Beta测试1月7日关闭。
articles.limitations: 发售日来自Gematsu对Owlcat Games公告的报道；未直接取得发行商公告，语言、地区与定价未在材料中说明。

facts.text: Owlcat Games宣布，《Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy》将于2027年1月28日登陆PS5、Xbox Series和PC，PC版通过Steam、Epic Games Store与GOG发行，Switch 2版后续推出。

evidence.quote: Party-based, story-driven cRPG Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy will launch for PlayStation 5 , Xbox Series , and PC via Steam , Epic Games Store , and GOG on January 28, 2027, followed by Switch 2 at a later date, developer Owlcat Games announced.

facts.text: 本作是队伍制、剧情驱动的cRPG。玩家从审判庭侍僧起步，组建由狂热者与弃儿组成的战团调查犯罪和叛教，可招募亚人类、危险灵能者、无魂者乃至艾达灵族海盗、食肉克鲁特等异形同伴，并在调查与战术战斗中使用其独特技能。

evidence.quote: Players join the Inquisition beginning as lowly acolytes and form a war band of zealots and outcasts that investigate crimes and apostasy, rooting out evil before it is too late. Inquisitors must decide if they want to recruit abhumans like Cogg, dangerous psykers like Saro or Pariahs like Discordance, or even xenos like the mysterious Aeldari Corsair Laarthyr or the flesh-eating Kroot Ra’akhti.
Each companion has unique skills that contribute to the Inquisition’s cause, whether they are used in the revamped tactical combat encounters or in the form of advice given during the investigations.

facts.text: Founder’s Packs销售将持续到1月初，面向所有创始人的Beta测试于1月7日关闭，为正式发售做准备。

evidence.quote: Founder’s Packs for Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy can still be purchased on the website until the beginning of January. The Beta, currently available for all founders, will close its doors on January 7 in order to prepare for launch.

bilingual.title_en: Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy Set to Launch on January 28, 2027

sentences.en: Owlcat Games announced that Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy will launch on January 28, 2027, for PS5, Xbox Series, and PC, with the PC version available via Steam, Epic Games Store, and GOG, and a Switch 2 version to follow.
sentences.zh: Owlcat Games宣布，《Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy》将于2027年1月28日登陆PS5、Xbox Series和PC，PC版通过Steam、Epic Games Store与GOG发行，Switch 2版后续推出。

sentences.en: This title is a party-based, story-driven cRPG.
sentences.zh: 本作是队伍制、剧情驱动的cRPG。

sentences.en: Players begin as an Acolyte of the Inquisition and assemble a warband of zealots and outcasts to investigate crimes and apostasy; they can recruit subhumans, dangerous psykers, blanks, and even xenos companions such as Aeldari pirates and carnivorous Kroot, and use their unique skills in investigations and tactical combat.
sentences.zh: 玩家从审判庭侍僧起步，组建由狂热者与弃儿组成的战团调查犯罪和叛教，可招募亚人类、危险灵能者、无魂者乃至艾达灵族海盗、食肉克鲁特等异形同伴，并在调查与战术战斗中使用其独特技能。

sentences.en: Sales of Founder’s Packs will continue until early January, and the Beta test for all founders closes on January 7 in preparation for the official release.
sentences.zh: Founder’s Packs销售将持续到1月初，面向所有创始人的Beta测试于1月7日关闭，为正式发售做准备。

articles.title: 《FragPunk》推出Farlands，已在PC和主机开启全球Early Access
articles.summary: Bad Guitar Studio宣布《FragPunk》新章节Farlands已在PC和主机开启全球Early Access。Farlands是永久性多人送货PvPvE冒险，数十名玩家共享持续演进世界。
articles.new_facts: Farlands已在PC和主机全球Early Access上线；为永久性多人送货PvPvE冒险，服务器五日循环并受玩家行为影响。
articles.limitations: 来源为Xbox Wire刊载的开发团队官方文章；具体收费模式、语言与地区支持未在材料中说明。

facts.text: Bad Guitar Studio宣布，《FragPunk》迄今规模最大的新章节Farlands已在PC和主机开启全球Early Access。

evidence.quote: FragPunk has launched its biggest new chapter yet with Farlands , a permanent, multiplayer delivery-driven PvPvE adventure where dozens of players share a persistent world, now available in Global Early Access on PC and console.

facts.text: Farlands是永久性多人送货PvPvE冒险，数十名玩家共享一个持续演进的世界。每个服务器以五天为周期持续运行，玩家的战斗和采集会影响服务器内阵营等级，改变敌对势力的强度、数量和分布；高温、寒冷和降雨会加速生命流失并影响运货。

evidence.quote: Persistent Sandbox Combat: Each server operates on a five-day cycle, with in-game time progressing continuously. Players can repeatedly return to the same server to gather resources, complete orders, and engage in combat. Their actions, including fighting enemies, contribute to changes in faction levels within the server, affecting the strength, number, and distribution of hostile forces.
Weather conditions such as heat, cold, and rain accelerate the depletion of players’ health and affect cargo transportation.

facts.text: 玩家可通过全球语音和表情系统临时结盟护送高价货物，也可能在关键时刻反目；成功运送获得的资源可用于强化个人装备和基地。

evidence.quote: Farlands features global voice chat and an emote system, allowing players to communicate during combat and deliveries. Strangers may reach temporary agreements to escort valuable cargo together, only to turn against one another at a critical moment and claim the loot for themselves.
Resources earned from successful deliveries can be invested in strengthening personal equipment and developing bases.

bilingual.title_en: FragPunk Launches Farlands Into Global Early Access on PC and Consoles

sentences.en: Bad Guitar Studio has announced that Farlands, the largest new chapter in FragPunk to date, has entered global Early Access on PC and consoles.
sentences.zh: Bad Guitar Studio宣布，《FragPunk》迄今规模最大的新章节Farlands已在PC和主机开启全球Early Access。

sentences.en: Farlands is a persistent multiplayer delivery PvPvE adventure in which dozens of players share a continuously evolving world.
sentences.zh: Farlands是永久性多人送货PvPvE冒险，数十名玩家共享一个持续演进的世界。

sentences.en: Each server runs on a five-day cycle, and players' combat and gathering affect faction levels on that server, changing the strength, numbers, and distribution of hostile forces; high heat, cold, and rain accelerate health drain and affect cargo delivery.
sentences.zh: 每个服务器以五天为周期持续运行，玩家的战斗和采集会影响服务器内阵营等级，改变敌对势力的强度、数量和分布；高温、寒冷和降雨会加速生命流失并影响运货。

sentences.en: Players can use global voice and emote systems to temporarily form alliances to escort high-value cargo and may also turn against each other at critical moments; resources gained from successful deliveries can be used to upgrade personal equipment and bases.
sentences.zh: 玩家可通过全球语音和表情系统临时结盟护送高价货物，也可能在关键时刻反目；成功运送获得的资源可用于强化个人装备和基地。

articles.title: 《Medabots Classics Plus》12月登陆Steam，收录8款旧作
articles.summary: Imagineer与SUCCESS Corporation宣布《Medabots Classics Plus》2026年12月登陆Steam，分Kabuto Ver.和Kuwagata Ver.，日本各售5478日元；合集收录8款旧作。
articles.new_facts: Steam版2026年12月发售，分两版本，日本各5478日元；收录8款旧作；新增存档、加速与跳过功能，支持在线对战和零件交换。
articles.limitations: 来源为Gematsu与4Gamer对厂商公告的转述；未直接取得厂商公告原文，语言与地区支持未在材料中完整说明。

facts.text: Imagineer与开发商SUCCESS Corporation宣布，《Medabots Classics Plus》将于2026年12月在Steam发售，分为Kabuto Ver.和Kuwagata Ver.，日本各售5478日元。

evidence.quote: Publisher Imagineer and developer SUCCESS Corporation will release Medabots Classics Plus for PC via Steam in both Kabuto Ver. and Kuwagata Ver. in December in Japan for 5,478 yen each, the companies announced .

facts.text: 合集收录8款系列旧作，包括《Medabots》至《Medabots 5》以及《Medabots Navi》《Medabots G》《Medabots Two: CORE》。

evidence.quote: A historic collection of eight games from Medabots series. This collection includes the five numbered games in the series, from Medabots to Medabots 5: Susutake Mura no Tenkousei , as well as Medabots Navi , Medabots G , and Medabots Two: CORE .

facts.text: 合集加入随时存档读档、战斗跳过和最高8倍速等功能。

evidence.quote: While the original appeal of the games remain unchanged, the collection introduces convenient features like the ability to save and load at any time, a Robattle skip feature, and a high-speed mode.

facts.text: 卡布托版与锹形虫版之间支持在线对战和零件交换。

evidence.quote: It also supports online battles and parts trading between both the Kabuto Ver. and Kuwagata Ver.

bilingual.title_en: Medabots Classics Plus to Launch on Steam in December With 8 Classic Titles

sentences.en: Imagineer and developer SUCCESS Corporation have announced that Medabots Classics Plus will be released on Steam in December 2026 in Kabuto Ver. and Kuwagata Ver., priced at 5,478 yen each in Japan.
sentences.zh: Imagineer与开发商SUCCESS Corporation宣布，《Medabots Classics Plus》将于2026年12月在Steam发售，分为Kabuto Ver.和Kuwagata Ver.，日本各售5478日元。

sentences.en: The collection includes eight past titles in the series, including Medabots through Medabots 5, as well as Medabots Navi, Medabots G, and Medabots Two: CORE.
sentences.zh: 合集收录8款系列旧作，包括《Medabots》至《Medabots 5》以及《Medabots Navi》《Medabots G》《Medabots Two: CORE》。

sentences.en: The collection adds features such as saving and loading at any time, battle skip, and up to 8x speed.
sentences.zh: 合集加入随时存档读档、战斗跳过和最高8倍速等功能。

sentences.en: Online battles and parts exchange are supported between the Kabuto Ver. and Kuwagata Ver.
sentences.zh: 卡布托版与锹形虫版之间支持在线对战和零件交换。

articles.event_key: Sea of Remnants|开启Dawnbreaker封闭测试|待确认平台
articles.title: 《Sea of Remnants》Dawnbreaker封闭测试12月3日开启
articles.summary: 网易游戏与Joker Studio宣布，免费海洋冒险RPG《Sea of Remnants》的Dawnbreaker封闭测试12月3日开始，覆盖PS5、Xbox Series、PC、iOS和Android，12月1日开放预下载。
articles.new_facts: Dawnbreaker封闭测试12月3日开始，覆盖PS5、Xbox Series、PC、iOS、Android；12月1日预下载；游戏计划2027年初上线。
articles.limitations: 来源为Gematsu对厂商公告的转述；未直接取得官方公告，语言与地区支持未在材料中明确。

facts.text: 网易游戏与Joker Studio宣布，免费海洋冒险RPG《Sea of Remnants》的Dawnbreaker封闭测试将于12月3日开始，覆盖PS5、Xbox Series、PC（专用启动器）、iOS（TestFlight）和Android。预下载12月1日开放，测试资格有限，按先到先得发放。

evidence.quote: Publisher NetEase Games and developer Joker Studio will host the “Dawnbreaker” closed beta test for free-to-play oceanic adventure RPG Sea of Remnants starting December 3

The test will be available for PlayStation 5 , Xbox Series , PC via a dedicated launcher, iOS via TestFlight, and Android. Pre-download will begin on December 1, with access being limited and granted on a first-come, first-served basis.

facts.text: 测试提供21名可玩角色，开放白海和桥海两个新区域及新任务，新增两艘初始船可选，并加入高难度挑战Peril Theatre。

evidence.quote: The Dawnbreaker closed beta test will feature 21 playable characters

Players can explore two newly opened regions, the White Sea and Bridge Sea, alongside new Journey and Roaming Quests scattered throughout these waters. The test also introduces two starting ship options.
the new high-difficulty challenge Peril Theatre will put team compositions and tactical skills to the test.

facts.text: 游戏计划2027年初正式上线PS5、Xbox Series、PC（Steam）、iOS和Android；完全共享世界的多人冒险会在上线后逐步实装。

evidence.quote: Sea of Remnants is due out for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series, PC via Steam , iOS, and Android in early 2027.
The fully shared-world multiplayer adventure is planned for progressive implementation after launch

bilingual.title_en: Sea of Remnants' Dawnbreaker Closed Beta Opens December 3

sentences.en: NetEase Games and Joker Studio have announced that the Dawnbreaker closed beta test for the free-to-play ocean adventure RPG Sea of Remnants will begin on December 3 on PS5, Xbox Series, PC (via a dedicated launcher), iOS (via TestFlight), and Android.
sentences.zh: 网易游戏与Joker Studio宣布，免费海洋冒险RPG《Sea of Remnants》的Dawnbreaker封闭测试将于12月3日开始，覆盖PS5、Xbox Series、PC（专用启动器）、iOS（TestFlight）和Android。

sentences.en: Pre-downloads will open on December 1, with a limited number of test slots allocated on a first-come, first-served basis.
sentences.zh: 预下载12月1日开放，测试资格有限，按先到先得发放。

sentences.en: The test will offer 21 playable characters, open two new regions—the White Sea and the Bridge Sea—and new quests, add two selectable starting ships, and introduce the high-difficulty challenge Peril Theatre.
sentences.zh: 测试提供21名可玩角色，开放白海和桥海两个新区域及新任务，新增两艘初始船可选，并加入高难度挑战Peril Theatre。

sentences.en: The game is planned for official launch in early 2027 on PS5, Xbox Series, PC (Steam), iOS, and Android; its fully shared-world multiplayer adventure will be implemented gradually after launch.
sentences.zh: 游戏计划2027年初正式上线PS5、Xbox Series、PC（Steam）、iOS和Android；完全共享世界的多人冒险会在上线后逐步实装。

articles.event_key: Dragon Quest RPG 魔界樹と導かれし島|公布2027年全球同步发行|待确认平台
articles.title: 《ドラゴンクエストRPG 魔界樹と導かれし島》公布，计划2027年全球同步发行
articles.summary: GREE Holdings公开IR信息，WFS与Square Enix共同开发的手机指令RPG《ドラゴンクエストRPG 魔界樹と導かれし島》计划2027年全球同步发行，登陆iOS和Android，采用基本免费加道具收费。
articles.new_facts: 作品计划2027年全球同步发行（部分地区除外），登陆iOS和Android，基本免费加道具收费；WFS开发，Square Enix企划制作。
entities: ドラゴンクエストRPG 魔界樹と導かれし島
articles.limitations: 来源为4Gamer对GREE Holdings IR信息的报道；未直接取得官方IR原文，游戏具体玩法与抽卡机制未在材料中说明。

facts.text: GREE Holdings于11月10日公开IR信息，旗下WFS与Square Enix共同开发的手机指令RPG《ドラゴンクエストRPG 魔界樹と導かれし島》计划2027年全球同步发行（部分地区除外），登陆iOS和Android，采用基本免费加道具收费。

evidence.quote: グリーホールディングスは本日（2026年11月10日），連結子会社のWFSがスクウェア・エニックスと共同開発するスマートフォン向けコマンドRPG 「ドラゴンクエストRPG 魔界樹と導かれし島」 （ iOS / Android ）に関するIR情報を公開した。 2027年にグローバル同時リリース（一部地域を除く）を予定している。料金形態は，基本プレイ無料のアイテム課金型だ。

facts.text: 开发由曾制作《Heaven Burns Red》的WFS负责，Square Enix负责企划与制作；堀井雄二任总导演，鸟山明负责角色设计，すぎやまこういち负责音乐。

evidence.quote: 制作スタッフとして，ゼネラルディレクターに堀井雄二氏，キャラクターデザインに鳥山明氏，音楽にすぎやまこういち氏がクレジットされている。開発は「ヘブンバーンズレッド」などを手がけるWFS，企画・制作はスクウェア・エニックスが担当する。

facts.text: 官方计划11月10日20:00在YouTube首播公布预告片。

evidence.quote: また，11月10日20：00にYouTubeでアナウンストレイラーがプレミア公開される予定だ。

bilingual.title_en: Dragon Quest RPG: Makai-ju to Michibikareshi Shima Announced for Global Simultaneous Release in 2027

sentences.en: GREE Holdings disclosed IR information on November 10, stating that the mobile command RPG Dragon Quest RPG: Makai-ju to Michibikareshi Shima, jointly developed by its WFS unit and Square Enix, is planned for a simultaneous global release in 2027 (excluding some regions), will launch on iOS and Android, and will adopt a free-to-play model with item purchases.
sentences.zh: GREE Holdings于11月10日公开IR信息，旗下WFS与Square Enix共同开发的手机指令RPG《ドラゴンクエストRPG 魔界樹と導かれし島》计划2027年全球同步发行（部分地区除外），登陆iOS和Android，采用基本免费加道具收费。

sentences.en: Development is handled by WFS, which produced Heaven Burns Red, while Square Enix is responsible for planning and production; Yuji Horii serves as general director, Akira Toriyama is responsible for character design, and Koichi Sugiyama is responsible for music.
sentences.zh: 开发由曾制作《Heaven Burns Red》的WFS负责，Square Enix负责企划与制作；堀井雄二任总导演，鸟山明负责角色设计，すぎやまこういち负责音乐。

sentences.en: The official plan is to premiere the announcement trailer on YouTube at 20:00 on November 10.
sentences.zh: 官方计划11月10日20:00在YouTube首播公布预告片。
